title: Concept: Signature recovery without signer checks (solidity) — review required
description: In solidity, ecrecover recovers a signer from signature parts. Unchecked results can be the zero address, and malleable signatures replay under a second encoding. The remedy is a zero-address check and a nonce.
applicability: solidity contracts verifying off-chain signatures; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged authorizations and signature replay; HIGH severity.
